requirement: A Joomla import stopped by an admin gate, a front-end login page, a broken certificate, an account that may not install, a blocked package download, HTTP Basic, a missing API door or a PHP too old names that reason, and the operator alert says where it stopped using only values from closed lists

oracle.ref: PR #1469 (fix); fix evidence: PR 1469. Before the fix each gate read as unreachable, install_failed, configure_failed, call_failed or invalid_credential, and a stuck import reached the operator with no place it stopped. Local Joomla 6.2 Docker stands (Super User, Administrator, Manager, a server 403 on the installer) were run during the change but not rerun after the last review fixes; this case pins the behaviour with the tests below.
oracle.invariant: Exit code 0 and `# fail 0`. Sign-in (import-gates): an RSFirewall Protected Area or a server 403 on the admin login page or on its POST is admin_gate; Joomla's own 403 on the login page or POST is unreachable with check joomla_denied; an address that lands on the home page is admin_form_not_found; a password form that is the front end's (com_users or task=user.* in its action or hidden fields) or that posts outside the administrator folder never receives the password; the secret word in the admin address rides on the login POST; a refused certificate is tls_invalid. Installer (import-gates, install-language): Joomla's own 403 on the installer page, the install POST or the page read again before the URL road is install_forbidden (the reason #1467 introduced), a server's 403 there is admin_gate; the slim package is uploaded first (#1568), so a site-side download that hangs is not waited on, and one that hung on the fallback but landed is not installed twice; PHP below the manifest's requires_php is php_too_old before anything is installed, and a parse error from the installed engine is php_too_old. Doors (import-gates): with the front door gated, the HTTP Basic credential reaches the administrator door and rides on every export call; no door answering, asked twice, is cowork_not_answering (the reason #1464 introduced) and a door dying on a parse error is php_too_old at once, both with a diagnostic naming the door; (handover-recovery) a pasted token no door answers on stops before any credential is registered or anything is read. Diagnostic (import-gates, beta-operation-signal): every stop carries {at, check, status?, path?, error?}; path is kept only when it is one of the Joomla paths the importer requests (after the site's base path), error only when it is a known network or TLS code (otherwise `other`); the web accepts the same closed lists, stores the diagnostic on the stuck signal, and the alert's Where line reads only accepted values.
